content: Saanvi Pillai contacted insurance agent Anita Sharma to request the critical-illness rider PDF brochure, which Anita promptly resent. Saanvi inquired about the monthly premium increase from $45 to $48, which Anita clarified included additional coverage benefits. Saanvi decided to proceed with adding the rider and requested to update her beneficiary to her sister, Maya Patel (DOB: 12/03/1992). Anita confirmed the requests and asked for a confirmation reply, which Saanvi provided. Anita also confirmed that the next premium due date remains November 15, 2026, and promised to send a final confirmation email.

action_items: Update the beneficiary to Maya Patel
Send a confirmation email to the customer
